text:
josh: Hi team — quick question. Booked a client trip in London on personal card because corporate card declined at checkout. Hotel charged GBP 420 (charged as 420.00 GBP) and later refunded one night (GBP 140 credit) because meeting moved. Card statement shows: hotel charge 420.00 GBP = $540.12 USD; refund 140.00 GBP = $179.99 USD. Which amounts do I submit? Do I split the receipt lines, or submit net? Also, there was a foreign transaction fee of $8.12 on my personal card. Can that fee be reimbursed?

people-ops: Short: submit the full original invoice and the refund evidence separately. We prefer line-item submissions when possible so finance can reconcile currency differences. Please do: 1) Expense the `hotel - lodging` for the full original GBP amount (attach original folio). 2) Create a separate expense for the refund/credit and attach the refund posting from the hotel or bank statement (tag `refund`). 3) File the FX fee under `bank/cc fees` with the card statement showing the fee. Manager approval required.

lina: To add — if the refund posted in a different currency amount than the original charge (common), finance will net it during reconciliation. That's why we need both documents. If you already used per diem for meals, keep those separate.

finance: Note: we reimburse FX fees on personal cards only when the charge was for company travel and the corporate card was unavailable/declined. Please include a screenshot of the corporate card decline or the error message if you have it. We'll cap reimbursement to the fee shown on the bank statement.

josh: I have a screenshot of the `card declined` modal from the hotel payment page and the bank statement with the $8.12 fee. Should I convert GBP->USD in the expense or leave as GBP?

people-ops: Leave amounts in original currency on the receipts. In the expense form pick the currency `GBP` and attach the USD card posting as well. The system will convert to USD using the date-of-charge rate. Add a note like: "Corporate card declined; personal card used. Refund posted for one night (attach refund). FX fee claim."

manager-emma: Approved provided receipts and decline screenshot are attached. If finance needs more info they'll loop us in.

travel-bot: Reminder: if you receive a later corporate-card credit for the same charge, notify people-ops@redwood.com — we may reduce the personal reimbursement to avoid double-payments.

josh: Thanks — filing now. tagging @finance and will attach everything. :pray:
